source.text: Locally advanced and unresectable or metastatic
Patients with untreated and/or non-stable brain metastases
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status (PS) 0-1
Must have had at least 2 prior lines of anti-HER2-directed therapy
Must have progression on, or disease recurrence after at least one line of SOC treatment
no prior systemic therapy in the aBC setting permitted
One prior line of irinotecan-containing therapy for locally advanced or metastatic CRC is allowed but not required
Patients with KRAS mutant aCRC who have KRAS G12R mutation
Patients with KRAS mutant aNSCLC who have KRAS G12R mutation
